headline: A 10-Year Treasury Bond Now Pays More Than 118 Of America's Biggest Companies
summary: Only 3.85% of S&P 500 stocks now yield more than the 10-year Treasury, the lowest since May 2007. Benzinga found 118 mega-caps that pay less.

headline: Short-Duration Treasury ETFs Are Looking Safer as US Debt Tops $40 Trillion
summary: U.S. debt hits $40T as long-term Treasury yields surge, putting TLT and other bond ETFs under pressure while boosting the case for short-duration funds.
